Assemble the rice cakes just before eating. Left made up, the moisture from the turkey softens them within 10 minutes.
Monta: pan tostado, las verduras saltead: Assemble: toast, the fried vegetables on top and the ham over that, left whole. Do NOT add salt: the ham brings it.
Móntalo justo antes de comer: montado co: Assemble it just before eating: made up in advance, the bread soaks through and folds when you pick it up.
Mueve la sartén en círculos, sin parar,: Swirl the pan in circles, without stopping, for 2 or 3 minutes. The oil and the gelatine gradually come together into a pale, thick sauce. It is a matter of persistence: nothing seems to happen until suddenly it emulsifies.
Muslos secos y salados, piel abajo 6 o 7: Thighs dried and salted, skin down 6 or 7 minutes without moving until the skin is crisp, turn, 5 minutes. Clear juice = done.
Muslos secos y salados, piel abajo en la: Thighs dried and salted, skin down in the same pan 6 or 7 minutes without moving until the skin is crisp, turn, 5 minutes. Clear juice when pierced = done.
Muslos secos y salados, piel abajo en un: Thighs dried and salted, skin down in a pan with a teaspoon of oil 6 or 7 minutes without moving until the skin is crisp, turn, 5 minutes. Clear juice = done.
NADA MÁS APAGAR, pásalos a un bol con ag: THE MOMENT YOU TURN IT OFF, move them to a bowl of iced water (or very cold tap water) for 5 minutes. This stops the cooking: without the cold water the yolk takes on a grey-green ring and tastes of sulphur.
NO añadas sal: la pone toda el jamón. Un: Do NOT add salt: the ham brings all of it. A drizzle of raw oil and pepper.
No destapes cada poco: cada vez que leva: Do not keep lifting the lid: every time you do, the steam escapes and has to build up again.
No lo pases: cuando deja de estar rosa p: Do not overcook it: once the outside is no longer pink and it releases clear juice, it is done.
No lo sales. El ahumado ya viene bastant: Do not salt it. Smoked fish comes salty enough already.
NO LO TOQUES. Con una cuchara, ve echand: DO NOT TOUCH IT. With a spoon, baste the hot oil from the pan over the white: it sets the top without turning it and leaves the yolk runny.
No los pongas bajo el grifo con agua cal: Do not put them under hot running water to speed things up: they fall apart and lose all their juice.
Para el huevo frito: calienta una sartén: For the fried egg: heat a small pan with a tablespoon of oil over a medium-high heat until a drop of water sizzles.
Para el huevo frito: sube el aceite (una: For the fried egg: bring the oil (a tablespoon) up over a medium-high heat until a drop of water sizzles.
Parte el tomate por la mitad y frótalo c: Cut the tomato in half and rub it hard against the crumb, until all you are left holding is the skin.
Parte las nueces con los dedos en trozos: Break the walnuts into large pieces with your fingers, do not chop them: in big pieces you notice them, chopped they disappear.
Parte las nueces en trozos con los dedos: Break the walnuts into pieces with your fingers or with the flat of the knife.
Break the walnuts into pieces with your fingers.
Pasa el huevo a agua fría 2 minutos y pé: Move the egg to cold water for 2 minutes and peel it from the fat end.
Move the egg to cold water for 2 minutes and peel it starting from the fat end, where the air pocket is.
PÁSALO A UN PLATO Y DÉJALO REPOSAR 5 MIN: MOVE IT TO A PLATE AND LET IT REST FOR 5 MINUTES before slicing. Cut it straight out of the pan and all the juice runs onto the plate and the meat is left dry. This step is half the result.
Pásalos a agua fría y pélalos ahí dentro: Move them to cold water and peel them in it: the water gets between the shell and the white and it comes off in one piece.
Pásalos a un bol con agua fría 2 minutos: Move them to a bowl of cold water for 2 minutes and peel them starting from the fat end.
Patata cocida en rodajas, dorada 3 minut: Boiled potato in slices, browned for 3 minutes a side in the same pan.
Patata cocida en rodajas, dorada en una: Boiled potato in slices, browned in a pan for 3 minutes a side. Take it out.

Patatas en dados a hervir 15-20 minutos,: Diced potatoes on to boil for 15-20 minutes, until a knife goes in.
Patatas en dados grandes a hervir 15-20: Potatoes in large dice on to boil for 15-20 minutes, until a knife goes in.
Pavo en tiras finas, seco y salado, en l: Turkey in thin strips, dried and salted, in the same pan for 4 minutes until the pink is gone. Out straight away.
Pavo en tiras finas, seco y salado. Mism: Turkey in thin strips, dried and salted. Same pan, medium-high heat, 4 minutes until the pink is gone. The moment it is done, out: it is lean.
Pavo picado en la misma sartén SIN tocar: Turkey mince into the same pan WITHOUT touching it for 1 minute; break it up and fry for 4 minutes. The moment it loses its pink, out.
Pela de arriba abajo siguiendo la curva,: Peel from top to bottom following the curve, taking off the white pith: that is the bitter part.
Peel from top to bottom following the curve, taking off all the white pith, which is the bitter part.
Pela el kiwi con una cuchara (gira la fr: Peel the kiwi with a spoon (turn the fruit against the spoon between skin and flesh) and cut it into wedges.
